selection: All 24 assigned observations of each first author, without filtering by first verdict.

supplemental_physical_evidence.purpose: Record the physical target and whole-boundary findings already checked during each actual second inspection, avoiding a later request to reconstruct undocumented visual conclusions.
supplemental_physical_evidence.judgment_values: true, false or null; unknown remains null
supplemental_physical_evidence.blinding_disclosure: This is second review with first business answers visible; it is not a separate blind identity review.
supplemental_physical_evidence.subsequent_requirements: Bound source georeferencing and independent cross-asset/grouping review; no geometric group is automatically promoted to an independent physical asset.
